AccreditationAccessEvent.description: Board 8.4. **Granted access against used access is the whole of the annual review.**

AccreditationAuditRecord.description: Board 8.7. **Who gave this person access to that place, when, and on whose authority.**

AccreditationHolder.description: **A subject who may never sign in to anything.** `identity` owns principals; this owns accredited people.

ApiClient.description: CF-135a. **The one credential model.** 2.7.52, 7.1.25 and 7.1.30 each asserted their own, so a partner API key, a POS integration credential and a webstore credential were three unrelated things with three lifecycles.

environment.description: **Bound to one, stated on the object rather than by naming convention.** A key that works in both is a key somebody will use in the wrong one.

scopes.description: **Resolved against the tenant's licence at token issue** (13.3.24). A scope granted here and not licensed there produces no token — and the refusal is at issue rather than at call time, so an integrator finds out in testing.

allowedTenantIds.description: 13.1.46. **Which tenants this client may act for.** A developer integrating for one venue must not reach another, and a client with an empty list reaches none.

ipAllowList.description: 13.1.38. Optional, and the strongest control available where an integrator has fixed egress.

lastUsedAt.description: **A credential unused for a year is a credential nobody will notice being stolen.**

KpiValue.description: BI board 10.3. **Value, target, variance, direction and freshness in one read.**

stale.description: **True when the pipeline behind it has not refreshed.** A number nobody flagged as stale is a number somebody will act on.

MetricValue.description:
**A reading of a metric or KPI, or a threshold on one.** A `Money` where the metric is money-valued — `MetricSource` lists those in `x-ticvai-money-valued`, and a KPI is when its `unit` is `currency` — and a plain number otherwise. naming-and-style 5.1: money is never a float, at any layer.
Stored as `numeric(18,4)` either way: a money value stores its amount, and currency and scale resolve from the scope as they do for every `Money`.

WebhookSubscription.description: 13.1.26, 13.3.18 and 13.3.22. **The 29 events already exist and nothing outside could receive one.**

eventTypes.description: **Filtered at subscription, not at delivery.** A subscriber taking every event and discarding 99% is a subscriber the platform pays to talk to.

filters.description: 13.3.22. Tenant, venue, or a business condition on the payload.

signingSecret.description:
**How the receiver knows it was TICVAI.** Without a signature an endpoint accepts a ticket-sale event from anybody who learns the URL.
**Write-only: accepted on create, never returned.** The same rule as `clientSecret` — a system that can show you a secret later is a system that hands it to whoever reads the subscription.

disabledReason.description: 13.1.29. **An endpoint failing for days is disabled rather than retried forever**, and the developer is told — a queue growing against a dead endpoint is a cost the platform carries silently.
